{{Quote|My chronological circuits have marked over ten full revolutions of this system's outermost planet around the sun since the Builders left.|translated=1|The [[Overseer (droid)|Overseer]]|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Purnell''' was the eighth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Dina/Legends|Dina]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Purnell had six [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the four [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]], except [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
